_why: A byte-identity project must not build on a moving toolchain. CI's emsdk
was unpinned and moved mid-deploy once already: emcc stopped linking
libc++ and the wasm link broke (FORK_NOTES v0.9.1, the toolchain pin
flag). This file is the single place that says which Emscripten builds
the engine, so a fresh clone and CI agree and the nine-cell gate keeps
meaning the same thing on every machine.
To move it: bump deliberately, rebuild both flavors, run the gate, and
record the new version here in the same commit.
override: set JM_ALLOW_TOOLCHAIN_DRIFT=1 to build anyway, knowing the bytes may move
